svg.title: Hybrid KV window model
svg.desc: Some transformer layers keep full-context KV while sliding-window layers keep only a recent token window, so total KV capacity depends on the mix of layer types rather than one uniform formula.
svg.text: Experiment 54–55：Hybrid KV 不能用“所有层 × full context”一刀切估算
Full-attention layer：保留整个 context 的 K/V
Sliding-window layer：更旧 token 已不再保留
full layers × T + window layers × min(T, W)；再乘 KV heads、head dim、K/V 两份与 element bytes。
